sloka: अध्यारोहन्त ज़तज़ह् सुवेलम् यत्र राघवह् ।ते त्व् अदीर्घेण कालेन गिरिम् आरुह्य सर्वतह् ।। ६-३८-१४।।
transliteration: adhyārohanta ja़taja़h suvelam yatra rāghavah ।te tv adīrgheṇa kālena girim āruhya sarvatah ।। 6-38-14।।

translations.english: All of them in no time ascended the mountain peak and saw the city of Lanka which was as if clinging closely to the sky and hanging.
